titolo: Hebbia reports GPT‑6 Astra outperforms rivals in financial research tests
descr: In Hebbia’s evaluation, GPT‑6 Astra led alternatives by 13.6 points on source citation and 14.4 points on presentation quality.
paragrafi: The model was judged on two tasks: locating source documents for banker queries and generating PowerPoint decks that follow a brief.
GPT‑6 Astra scored 13.6 percentage points higher than the next best model on citing required source types, with 99.5% of its citations relevant.
On presentation requirements it met 97.9% of criteria, a 14.4‑point lead over the best alternative.
Kavita Anand of Hebbia said the model’s precise outputs and adherence to branding could cut deck‑creation time from hours to minutes.
perche: For finance professionals, the gains in citation accuracy and slide quality mean faster, more reliable deal‑room analysis. Users of free or locally hosted models may see a larger performance gap, highlighting the advantage of premium offerings like GPT‑6 Astra for high‑stakes research.
